inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Adequate Lighting During Naptime: During nap time a classroom was observed without adequate lighting. This was corrected when the daycare added a lamp at time of inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Adequate Lighting During Naptime (26 TAC §746.2911)

occurrences.finding: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Label Bottles/Cups: Two infant bottles were observed at time of investigation inspection not labeled with first name and last initial.     This was corrected at time of inspection when bottles were labeled by caregiver.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Label Bottles/Cups (26 TAC §746.2419(6))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: Two children within the age range of ages served by the operation were unsupervised at the front lobby for approximately 3 or more minutes.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Nutrition and Food Service - Second Serving: Based on the information obtained, it was determined that second servings of required meal components have not been available consistently, beginning end of 2025 into 2026.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Nutrition and Food Service - Second Serving (26 TAC §746.3301(e))

occurrences.finding: Nutrition and Food Service - Follow Meal Patterns: Based on the information obtained, it was determined that required meal patterns have not been met consistently, beginning end of 2025 into 2026.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Nutrition and Food Service - Follow Meal Patterns (26 TAC §746.3301(b))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - 24 Annual training: A caregiver did not have proof of 24 hours of annual training on file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - 24 Annual training (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(5)(A))

occurrences.finding: First Aid Kit Incomplete - Thermometer, preferably non-glass: The vehicle used for transportation on the day of inspection did not have a working thermometer.
occurrences.violation_type_title: First Aid Kit Incomplete - Thermometer, preferably non-glass (26 TAC §746.4003(a)(7))

occurrences.finding: Electronic or Battery-Operated Carbon Monoxide Detector-Document Test Date, Battery Installation Date, and Staff Name Testing and Installation: Testing of the downstairs and upstairs carbon monoxide detectors were not documented.    The detectors were tested during inspection and were working.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Electronic or Battery-Operated Carbon Monoxide Detector-Document Test Date, Battery Installation Date, and Staff Name Testing and Installation (26 TAC §746.5537(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device: An infant was observed sleeping in a restrictive device. The caregiver stated that the infant had been asleep for approximately 30 minutes.    The caregiver proceeded to remove the infant from the restrictive device once notified of the deficiency.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device (26 TAC §746.2426(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Requirement of Gas Leak Inspection: The 2 year gas leak inspection is past due. The last inspection was on 3/6/2023.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Requirement of Gas Leak Inspection (26 TAC §746.5401)

occurrences.finding: Transportation Safety Training -Director and Employee Complete 2 Hours Annually: One caregiver who transports children did not have current transportation training.    This was corrected with the caregiver completing the training during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Transportation Safety Training -Director and Employee Complete 2 Hours Annually (26 TAC §746.1316(a))

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: One employee had access to children in care prior to the operation receiving a background check result of eligible, eligible with conditions, or provisionally eligible.    The employee was excluded from being present at the time of inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: Annual Sanitation Inspection: The annual health inspection was past due.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Sanitation Inspection (26 TAC §746.3401(a))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Grabbing and Pulling: It was determined that there was sufficient evidence that a caregiver grabbed and pulled a child by the arm and shirt to redirect the child when not following the caregiver's directions.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Grabbing and Pulling (26 TAC §746.2805(3))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - 24 Annual training: 2 caregivers did not have all required 24 hours of annual training for their last complete training period.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - 24 Annual training (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(5)(A))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact: Two children's records were missing full emergency contact information.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact (26 TAC §746.605(6))

occurrences.finding: Sheltering Drills for Lock-Down-4 times in a calendar year: The operation needed 3 more lock-down drills for 2023.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Sheltering Drills for Lock-Down-4 times in a calendar year (26 TAC §746.5205(3))

occurrences.finding: Electronic or Battery-Operated Carbon Monoxide Detector-Check All Detectors Monthly: Carbon monoxide detectors were not documented as tested from January through March of 2024.    The detectors was tested during the inspection and working properly.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Electronic or Battery-Operated Carbon Monoxide Detector-Check All Detectors Monthly (26 TAC §746.5537(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Sheltering Drill For Severe Weather-Four times a calendar year: The operation needed one more severe weather drill for 2023.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Sheltering Drill For Severe Weather-Four times a calendar year (26 TAC §746.5205(2))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Immunizations: Two children's immunization records were not current.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §746.603(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: The operation's driver did not use good judgment while transporting children, as the driver failed to yield the right of way to another car. The act resulted in a two-vehicle collision between the operation's bus and the other car. The operation's driver was issued a citation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))

occurrences.finding: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes: Fire drills between January and August 2022 did not meet the required evacuation time of 3 minutes. The recorded evacuation times were between 3.5 minutes to 4.5 minutes.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes (26 TAC §746.5205(1))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Health Statement: Two children did not have a health statement on file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Health Statement (26 TAC §746.603(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric CPR: Two caregivers did not have pediatric CPR training on file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric CPR (26 TAC §746.1315(b))

occurrences.finding: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking.: Two caregivers did not have pediatric first aid training on file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking. (26 TAC §746.1315(a))

occurrences.finding: No Swaddling of Infant Unless Completed Sleep Exception Form on File: An infant under 12 months old was observed swaddled while asleep in their crib.
occurrences.violation_type_title: No Swaddling of Infant Unless Completed Sleep Exception Form on File (26 TAC §746.2428)

occurrences.finding: Discipline - Positive Methods of Discipline and Guidance: It was determined that a caregiver did not redirect a child using positive methods of redirection, such as with appropriate verbal redirection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Discipline - Positive Methods of Discipline and Guidance (26 TAC §746.2803(4))

occurrences.finding: Food Allergy Emergency Plan Signed by Parents and Health Care Professional: One child had a formed signed by a doctor stating a food allergies, but there was no food allergy plan available for review at the time of inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Food Allergy Emergency Plan Signed by Parents and Health Care Professional (26 TAC §746.3819)

occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees and Caregivers - Pre-service Training (26 TAC §746.1301(2)(A))

occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §746.603(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Garbage Inaccessible to Children; Maintained in Sanitary Manner: A garbage can in a restroom had no lid and a used diaper in the garbage can that was accessible to children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Garbage Inaccessible to Children; Maintained in Sanitary Manner (26 TAC §746.3407(8))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Play Materials and Equipment Safe: There were broken materials on the playground, and a fence panel that was missing and broken.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Play Materials and Equipment Safe (26 TAC §746.3701(5))

occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training- Required Content (26 TAC §746.1309(e))

occurrences.finding: Required Postings-Child's Food Allergies: One children with a documented food allergy was not listed on the food allergy posting on the wall at the time of inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Postings-Child's Food Allergies (26 TAC §746.401(10))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Monthly Maintenance Checklist: A monthly checklist was not available for review at the time of inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Monthly Maintenance Checklist (26 TAC §746.4751(b))
